# Thursday book club

- Started two years ago at the library. Fourteen people came to the first meetings; the last three had 6, 5 and 6.
- Two people who stopped coming said the books were too long to finish in a month.
- One member said Thursday at 7pm clashes with her evening class.
- The library room is free. There is no money for books, so members buy or borrow their own.
- I run it alone and have about two hours a month for it.
